PluginInfo.Name: VNC (based on Apple Screen Sharing)
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Connect to macOS, Windows and Linux using VNC.
PluginInfo.Description:
Connect to macOS, Windows and Linux Computers using Apple Remote Desktop/Screen Sharing or VNC.

The Apple Screen Sharing based VNC plugin enables you to connect to remote hosts running Apple Remote Desktop/Screen Sharing or VNC. Since it uses Apple Screen Sharing as it's underlying core you can expect first class support for connecting to remote Macs.

Security
  • macOS authentication support
  • Support for requesting permissions to access remote Mac
  • Support for locking remote Mac's screen
  • Apple Screen Sharing encryption support
  • VNC authentication support

Advanced Features
  • Clipboard sharing support
  • Drag and Drop file transfer support
  • Multi-Display support
  • Screen scaling support
  • Support for adaptive and full quality settings
  • Customizable keyboard behavior
  • Secure Gateway support
